title: tpt-sandbox policy
description: Policy file for tpt-sandbox --policy. The same schema is used by the built-in profiles.

allow_read.description: Paths the command may read. Relative paths resolve against the current directory.

allow_write.description: Paths the command may read and write.

allow_exec.description: Paths the command may execute from.

system_paths.description: Grant read and exec on /usr, /bin, /sbin, /lib and /lib64 (those that exist).

no_network.description: Run in a network namespace with no external access.

drop_caps.description: Drop all Linux capabilities before exec.

cpu_quota.description: CPU quota as a percentage of one core.

pids_limit.description: Maximum number of processes and threads (cgroup pids.max).

new_root.description: Directory to use as the new root (pivot_root).

cwd.description: Working directory for the command (inside new_root if one is set).

seccomp.description: enforce: allowlist with EPERM for other calls. log: allow all, log only. off: no filter.

pass_env.description: Environment variables passed through in addition to PATH, TERM, LANG, LC_ALL and LC_CTYPE.

pid_namespace.description: Run the command in its own PID namespace, so it is PID 1 and cannot see or signal host processes.

isolate_ipc.description: Block connections to abstract Unix sockets and signals to processes outside the sandbox (Linux 6.12+).

allow_tcp_bind.description: TCP ports the command may bind. Once any port is listed, other ports are denied (Linux 6.7+).

allow_tcp_connect.description: TCP ports the command may connect to. Once any port is listed, other ports are denied (Linux 6.7+).
